svg.text: One fact table at order-line grain, surrounded by five conformed dimensions. Power BI reads only these tables.
Control tables (schemas etl and dq): ETL configuration, audit log and data-quality results, outside the star
Legend: PK primary key (surrogate, INT IDENTITY ◆) · FK foreign key · UQ unique business key from the source · NN NOT NULL · ─|| one ─< many
Every dimension holds an 'Unknown' member with key -1, so fact rows whose lookups fail still load and can be counted.
order_id and line_id in fact_sales are degenerate dimensions (kept for counting orders and tracing lines to the source).
